verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote large and dominant with the attribution directly beneath it. However, the 'GROVE TASTING TEAM' line and the logo strip run into the edge of the background circle, and the logo is centred while all the text is left-aligned. The bottle sits small and off-centre in the circle, leaving the bottom-left empty. B squeezes the quote into a narrow, smaller column and pushes the attribution into an awkward side column that competes with the quote and breaks the reading order. The circle and bottle are cleanly centred, but the whole block sits on an arbitrary left indent and leaves a large dead area on the right.
